title: Fix MemoryIndex read-side locking before TSK-3077 wires live reads
description:
Fix MemoryIndex read-side locking before TSK-3077 (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md

Problem: MemoryIndex added writer locking, but readers are still unsynchronized, enabling read/write races. Add concurrent read-safe patterns, e.g., ReaderWriterLockSlim with read locks or copy-on-write snapshot for readers.

Acceptance criteria:
- Implement read-locks or snapshot reads for MemoryIndex public query methods
- Add concurrency unit tests exercising concurrent read/write with assertions
- Document the locking strategy in `MemoryIndex.cs` header comment

Effort: 1d

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive reverified that MemoryIndex exposes mutable dictionaries/sets directly while only writers are locked. Read-side enumeration or caller mutation can race with Add/Remove/Rebuild. Keep the read-side locking/snapshot contract explicit before live index reads are wired.
